blind.B1: No for an in-vivo exercise question. GSE242861 is RNA-seq of 18 cultured primary myotube samples (3 male + 3 female donors x scramble / miR-30a / miR-30c mimic, 24 h; S5.9.1.p1, S5.9.2.p1, packet A metadata). No sample carries an exercise factor (packet A: no exercise words). The exercise data (pre/post HIIE biopsies) are TaqMan miRNA arrays not in this series (S5.8.p1, DA.p1). Only link: miR-30 was picked because of its sex-specific exercise response (S2.6.p1), i.e. an in-vitro exercise-mediator design.
blind.B2: RNA-seq part: male vs female donor cells at baseline (26 genes, S2.7.p1); miR-30a vs scramble in males (N=3) and females (N=3) (S2.7.p2, FIG4); miR-30c vs scramble in males and females (S2.8.p1, FIG5). Each level: 3 samples per sex-by-treatment cell (donor x treatment 6 x 3).
blind.B3: Yes: each donor contributes one scramble, one miR-30a and one miR-30c sample (6 donors x 3). Key: `donor` (parsed from title), pairs every sample once across treatment, expression check supported (r diff 0.544, p 0.0005). The paper's DESeq2 model is stated as Genes ~ Sex * Condition with no donor term (S5.9.2.p1).
blind.B4: One joint model on all samples: 'Genes ~ Sex * Condition' (S5.9.2.p1); the paper does not say whether the per-sex contrasts were fitted separately (figures show per-sex MA plots).
blind.B5: FDR adjusted p < 0.05 (S5.9.3.p3, FIG4/FIG5 legends); no fold-change cutoff stated. Counts: 26 genes M vs F; miR-30a M 18 up/23 down, F 16 up/23 down; miR-30c M 13 up/12 down, F 10 up/11 down (S2.7-S2.8). Pre-filter: <10 RPM in <2 samples removed.

checks.evidence: Refusal matches B1: no exercise arm in the 18 samples; the in-vitro design is labelled as miRNA overexpression, not exercise (packet B design reasoning; S5.9.1.p1). Whether in-vitro exercise-mediator series count is an open policy question.
No analysis run. Alignment 18/18 exact; donor/tx/sex levels (6x3, 6/6/6, 9/9) match the paper's 3M+3F x 3 treatments (S5.9.1.p1).

No model fitted. The repeated-donor structure (donor pairs every sample once, expression check supported) is recorded in the rejected alternative 'donor blocked'; the flags unused_subject_like_column / pairing_key_candidate are therefore moot for a refusal. If the in-vitro contrasts are ever run, donor should be a blocking term and the paper's no-blocking model noted as a discrepancy.
No fit. Paper: joint Sex * Condition (S5.9.2.p1).
No sequencing batch column; sex is balanced across treatments (3 per cell). Nothing aliased with an exercise factor, which does not exist here.
Kallisto transcript estimated counts (36% non-integer, ENST IDs); DESeq2 after rounding/gene summarisation is the paper's route (S5.9.2.p1). Recorded correctly.
HANDBACK records FDR < 0.05 with no fold-change rule (S5.9.3.p3), matching B5.
HANDBACK claims no reproduction of the exercise miRNA counts and lists the RNA-seq counts (26; 18/23, 16/23, 13/12, 10/11) correctly as reference only.

'No exercise factor' is true: all 18 samples are cultured myotubes, packet A shows no exercise words in any column, and the exercise arrays are not in the series (DA.p1 cites only GSE242861 and Zenodo). Check was wide enough (metadata, all columns, paper).

human_items: Open policy: miR-30 was chosen from the exercise-response arrays (S2.6.p1), so GSE242861 is an in-vitro exercise-mediator series. Decide whether such series count as exercise studies; if yes, run miR-30a/c vs scramble with donor blocking (donor key supported) and record the paper's unblocked Sex * Condition model as a discrepancy.
summary: 拒绝运行是正确的：GSE242861 只含体外培养肌管的 miR-30 过表达 RNA-seq，没有运动因素，运动数据（TaqMan miRNA 阵列）不在该系列中。机械标记的 donor 配对在拒绝的情况下无需处理，但若政策上把体外运动介质系列算作运动研究，则应按 donor 作为区组运行。无 disagree 项，仅留一条开放政策问题给人工决定。
